text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with Yaeno Muteki,
she stopped in front of a secondhand bookstore.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono.
I humbly ask permission to make a slight detour.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I found an old book at this store
that I've wanted for quite some time,
so I was saving up funds to purchase it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A book documenting the physical training methods of various jujutsu styles...
It contains records of schools whose lineages have now died out, making it an exceedingly precious document.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Lost techniques... I look forward to discovering what lessons they may hold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I was waiting for Yaeno Muteki
in front of the shop, but...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...It's not here! That book is gone...!
I know for sure it was on that shelf...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Shopkeeper! There was a rare book on the back shelf...!
Did it already sell!?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Mm? Ah, a young lady bought the books
from that shelf just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Look, someone wearing the exact same uniform as you...
What academy was it again—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
A Tracen Academy student...!?
And if it happened just moments ago,
they must still be nearby...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I want to see just a few pages of its contents...!
I'm going after them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I got some great buys~♪
Alright, I'm gonna read them right here.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
That's... Ryan-san!
And what she's holding in her hand is a bag from that shop...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I thought Ryan-san was more of a specialist in modern training, but... hmm.
To think you're also interested in traditional training methods.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Ryan-san!
I have a once-in-a-lifetime request!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Yaeno?
What's wrong? Why do you look so desperate...?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"That book you purchased...
Would you please allow me to see it as well!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-What!?
Th-This!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I had no idea you were interested in "that sort of thing" as well, Ryan-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Which means... Yaeno, don't tell me you...
um... read stuff like this too?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "If anything, reflecting upon the path I have walked, not reading it would be negligence on my part."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...!?
Now I'm really curious about Yaeno's past!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And so, I'd love to join you! Please allow me to accompany you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, wait!
Alright! I'll show you, just calm down!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
!! Thank you very much!
I will never forget this favor for the rest of my life!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaaat!?!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh... What is this book?!
As soon as I opened it, a k-k... kiss...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait!? Don't say it out loud!
Even for a shojo manga, it's... well...
it's got a lot of pretty bold scenes, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-What is the meaning of this?!
I thought it contained the training methods of an ancient style...!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawa... A-And holding hands...
Eeeh, y-you'd even do something like that!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-W-Wait... stop!
Don't say it so loudly~~!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A-Ah-wa-wa-wa... *pssshhhh*...
choice_data_list: So this is the ancient style of training...
So where did that book go?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No!!
Absolutely not!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Th-This... it was all just a misunderstanding on my part... Ahh, seriously... why did this happen...?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Aaaah!! I'm such an idiot!!
Everyone is an idiooooot!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...By the way, it turned out that the old book
was simply moved to a different spot
when the shopkeeper organized the shelves."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I-Indeed... Where on earth
could they have gone?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Right... Exactly.
W-Well then, Ryan-san, pardon me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, what!? Hold on a second!?
Doesn't that just mean I embarrassed myself for nothing~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...By the way, it turned out that the old book
was simply moved to a different spot
when the shopkeeper organized the shelves."
